python3 -c '
import fcntl, subprocess
lock = open("/tmp/vps_git.lock", "w")
fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
try:
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", "fetch", "--depth", "20", "origin", "main", "--update-shallow"], check=True)
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", "rebase", "origin/main"])
    print("rebase rc:", r.returncode)
    if r.returncode == 0:
        r2 = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", "push", "origin", "main"])
        print("push rc:", r2.returncode)
    else:
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", "rebase", "--abort"])
        print("rebase failed, aborted")
finally:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
'
